description: The file defines a RestaurantProfile data class and a RestaurantProvider class that manages the restaurant's profile data, including loading profile info, checking if the restaurant is open, and formatting today's operating hours. It also imports dependencies related to Flutter UI, date formatting, geolocation, and notifications.

classes.name: RestaurantProfile
classes.description: A data class holding various details about a restaurant such as name, story, contact info, address, operating hours, and social media handle.

classes.name: RestaurantProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages and provides the restaurant's profile data, including loading data, checking open status, and formatting hours.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Loads or resets the restaurant profile data, currently using a seed profile as a placeholder.

methods.name: isOpenNow
methods.description: Determines if the restaurant is currently open based on current time and operating hours.

methods.name: todayHoursFormatted
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of today's operating hours or 'Closed' if not available.

methods.name: _seedProfile
methods.description: Creates and returns a default RestaurantProfile instance with preset data.
